policy:public.person_schedules.person_sc.check:
((origin_household_id = med_tracker.current_household_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM household_memberships actor
  WHERE ((actor.id = med_tracker.current_membership_id()) AND (actor.household_id = person_schedules.origin_household_id) AND ((actor.status)::text = 'active'::text) AND (actor.revoked_at IS NULL)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM household_memberships subject
  WHERE ((subject.person_id = person_schedules.person_id) AND (subject.household_id = person_schedules.origin_household_id) AND ((subject.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['active'::character varying, 'suspended'::character varying])::text[])) AND (subject.revoked_at IS NULL)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM schedules execution
  WHERE ((execution.id = person_schedules.origin_schedule_id) AND (execution.household_id = person_schedules.origin_household_id) AND (execution.person_id = person_schedules.person_id) AND (execution.execution_ended_at IS NULL)))))
